# tenarium_tenant_group (Resource)

A group (team) inside a tenant. Its members additionally hold the group's roles.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "tenarium_tenant_group" "oncall" {
  tenant_id   = tenarium_tenant.acme.id
  name        = "On-call"
  description = "Engineers paged at night"
  roles       = [tenarium_tenant_role.support.name]

  # Omit members to leave membership to SCIM or the UI.
  members = [tenarium_member.alice.id]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Group name, unique in the tenant.
- `tenant_id` (String) ID (or slug) of the tenant. Changing it replaces the resource.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Free-form description.
- `members` (Set of String) Member IDs (`tenarium_member.x.id`) in the group. When unset, Terraform does not manage membership (for example when SCIM provisions it).
- `roles` (Set of String) Built-in or custom roles granted to the group's members.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Group ID.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import tenarium_tenant_group.oncall <tenant_id>/<group_id>
```
